verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no natural-language command interface, assistant, or first-party MCP endpoint for YubiKey; the probe explicitly notes that no MCP endpoint exists. The ykman CLI and SDKs are scriptable building blocks an agent could drive, not a product-provided natural-language capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
